test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states has the giant squirrel as its state animal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Giant Squirrel (Shekaru in Marathi) is the state animal of the state of Maharashtra in western India**__.

 __
 
• The Indian giant squirrel is a multi-colored tree squirrel species endemic to forests and woodlands in India.
 
• It is a diurnal, arboreal, and mainly herbivorous squirrel.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra**__

 __
 
• Capital: Mumbai
 
• National Parks: Chandoli National Park, Gugamal National Park, Nawegaon National Park, Sanjay Gandhi National Park, Tadoba National Park.
 
• State Animal: Indian giant squirrel
 
• State Bird: Yellow-footed green pigeon
 
• State Tree: Mangifera Indica
 
• State Flower: Pride of India/Jarul
